verdicts.reason: A crams everything into a centred column: the subline is tiny and illegible at 320x50, the Enter Now CTA is shrunk to the size of the LIMITED badge beside it, so the two compete, and the right third of the banner is empty dead space. B keeps the original's left-to-right order (shoe, copy, CTA) with a readable headline and a clear CTA, but the shoe is reduced to a tiny unreadable icon, the subline is almost as large as the headline, and the LIMITED badge is jammed right on top of the button.
